newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee consumers continue 1997 buying.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee consumers continue 1997 buying.

text.p: German coffee roasters bought raw materials for early 1997 as well as spot, with Brazil the dominant origin, traders said.
While Brazil offered favourable differentials, Colombians were little changed and those in Central America slightly higher.
Kenyan supplies were getting tighter as roasters required East African and Asian arabicas for 1997 dates.
Robusta markets also saw some activity at steady levels while arabicas rose $6-12 per 50 kg fob on the week.
